dreams.text: The machine sleeps and sees WAR priced in WINTER, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of ELECTION devouring CHRISTMAS, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where LEGISLATIVE forgets it was ever about TRUMP.
Far ahead, VENEZUELA and OLYMPICS merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, WAR is law and WINTER is myth.
In the dream, FIFA crosses every chasm at once and finds IRAN already there.
